notes.title: Dungeons of Hinterberg – Final Quality of Life Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey there adventurers, 

We’re rolling out our final Quality of Life update packed with general fixes, polish, and some key improvements focused on combat flow and responsiveness. 

We’ve listened closely to your feedback and made tweaks to ensure that every dungeon battle feels smoother, sharper, and more satisfying — whether you're chaining magic abilities, dodging elite enemies, or just vibing with your sword and board. 

Update Highlights: 

Smoother UI and inventory management and handling 

Better visuals and immersion: New VFX  

Customisable sound experience: Option to turn off speech bubble sound effects. 

Improved localisation: Sharper Japanese fonts and better Chinese combo counter readability. 

New Game+ combat tweaks: Fine-tuned for a smoother late-game experience. 

Village life enhancements: HP/MP auto-reset at nightfall, and Luisa now changes into pyjamas for a better nights sleep, pre-slaying! 

We hope this update makes your time in Hinterberg even more magical. 

A Heartfelt Thank You 

Since launch, the outpouring of support for Dungeons of Hinterberg has meant the world to us. From the stunning fan art to the amazing reviews and comments — you've made this journey unforgettable. 

As a small independent studio, working on our first game it has truly meant the World, every player you share the love with and every review you leave makes a difference to us in so many ways 

Our dream was to create a game that transports players into a truly original world: a hidden village nestled in the Austrian Alps, where ancient magic, modern tourism, and Alpine folklore meet. Seeing you all connect with the characters, puzzles, and stories of Hinterberg has been a dream come true. 

 

💸 Biggest Discount Ever – Live Now in the Curve Publisher Sale! 

If you've been thinking of visiting Hinterberg — or want to gift a getaway to a fellow adventurer — now's the perfect time. Dungeons of Hinterberg is available at its biggest-ever discount as part of the Curve Games Publisher Sale. Don’t miss it! 

🛒 https://store.steampowered.com/sale/curvepublishersale2025 

 

🧳 What’s Next? 

With this update complete, the team will now be taking a well-earned rest (and maybe a real hike or two through the Alps 🌲). We’re incredibly proud of what we’ve built — and who knows? Perhaps the next adventure is already whispering in the mountain wind... 

Thank you for being part of Hinterberg. 
 We'll see you down the trail.

notes.title: Our biggest update yet! Episode Renaud - Available Now!
notes.content:
Get ready for a brand-new adventure in Episode Renaud, available now across all platforms, including the newly released versions on PlayStation 4 and 5! 

This exciting prequel introduces Renaud, the mysterious fan-favorite character, now fully playable. Dive into Renaud’s dark and intense journey, which offers thrilling new insights that connect directly to Luisa’s adventure in the main game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/7b1eff9df6eb0f0aa6351032fca87089fe15aff3.jpg[/img]


What to Expect in Episode Renaud: 
[list]
[*] New Playable Character: Step into the boots of Renaud and uncover his secrets. 
[*] Fresh Combat Mechanics: Master exciting new combat combinations and skills exclusive to Renaud’s playstyle. 
[*] 7 Compact Rifts: Explore seven new rifts that blend fast-paced combat with mind-bending puzzles. 
[*] A Darker, More Intense Narrative: Experience a deeper, more intense side of the story, leading straight into Luisa's adventure. 

Whether you’re a returning player or new to the world, Episode Renaud promises to deliver action, mystery, and unforgettable moments. 

The free content will be accessible from the main menu after you’ve progressed a short way through the main story with Luisa. 

We can't wait for you to explore Renaud's gripping story let us know what you think over in Discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/a790801bba2da5a7c985aa50e4722ea044e0a3b6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Free Winter Icons update available now!
notes.content:
[b]🎄 ‘Tis the Season in Dungeons of Hinterberg! New Free Holiday Costumes! 🎅🦌
[/b]
Adventurers of Hinterberg, the holiday season is upon us! 🌨️ As the snow falls and the fire crackles, we’re thrilled to bring you two brand-new, FREE seasonal cosmetics to help you celebrate the most magical (and mischievous) time of year! 

Introducing the Santa Costume 🎅 and the Krampus Costume 👹—now available in Dungeons of Hinterberg! 


[b]🎅 Santa Costume: Spread the Joy! 
[/b]
Step into the boots of the jolliest figure of all time! Feel the warmth of the season as you spread cheer (and maybe the occasional sword swing) across the slopes and dungeons. 

Did you know? Santa Claus has origins in folklore as Saint Nicholas, a 4th-century Greek bishop known for his generosity and miracles. Over the centuries, this figure blended with other winter traditions to become the Santa we know today—full of festive magic and good will! 

 
[b]👹 Krampus Costume: Embrace Your Dark Side! 
[/b]
For those of you who prefer a more... mischievous approach to the holidays, the Krampus Costume is here to channel your inner trickster. With twisted horns, fur-lined robes, and a menacing grin, you’ll be the fearsome folkloric legend of Hinterberg! 

Krampus, the horned creature of Alpine folklore, was said to punish naughty children during the festive season, often depicted as the shadowy counterpart to Saint Nicholas. With roots in pre-Christian traditions, Krampus represents the dark side of winter—where the line between celebration and chaos blurs. 

[b]How to Unlock the Costumes: 
[/b]
Both costumes are available to purchase in the shop.  No grinding required and you’ll be ready to strut your holiday style in no time. 

Get into the holiday spirit (or mischief) and dive into Dungeons of Hinterberg with your new seasonal outfits! Whether you’re delivering presents or punishing those who misbehave, the season is yours to celebrate. 

Happy Holidays from all of us at Microbird Games! 🎄

notes.title: Celebrate the New Game+ Update with a Dungeons of Hinterberg Midweek Deal!
notes.content:
Dungeons of Hinterberg has been selected for a Midweek Deal and is now 50% off for a limited time to celebrate the release of our New Game+ update!  There’s never been a better time to dive into Hinterberg’s magic—whether you’re picking it up for the first time or ready to relive the adventure with fresh features and exciting new ways to play. Don’t miss out—join players around the world in experiencing Dungeons of Hinterberg like never before! 
 

Here are some highlights from the New Game+ update. You can find a full breakdown at the end of the post. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/bcf3c2ada57f164f75b09ccce20c0aae7605a5fa.jpg[/img]

[b]ENGAGING REPLAYABILITY [/b]

The main goal of New Game+ is to provide players an enhanced second playthrough. You can play through the game from the start, while keeping your last playthrough's inventory, player stats, and most of the perks that you received from relationship level-ups! In addition, you can choose to either keep your past relationships or reset them and build them again from scratch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/cd1d670e061e1930a2288c6bd1bbf4998ab32e99.png[/img]


Enemies will pose a greater challenge. Some will have new melee shields; others will boast increased ranges or more intense attacks. Also, more enemies will have magic shields in general.  

To help deal with these nastier enemies, we’ve added 4 new attack conduits to give you additional combat options. 



[b]Downpour[/b] - Giant water projectiles that rain down from the sky. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/3dd42779ebe210908c05c6bf8154c5915c2c3d27.png[/img]

[b]Piercing Glance [/b]- Numerous eyes open in the void around Luisa, shooting lasers in all directions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/7016aeab2a99029e0ff75476ed2d0aa0dd292748.png[/img]

[b]Rage[/b] - Luisa's speed and damage is increased for a short period, while damage taken is also reduced. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/2867bd2e644511d9032623ce4413547b6b121d99.png[/img]

[b]Wind Dash[/b] - Luisa dashes forward, damaging everything in her path. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/39eb391ac4e0a9c9c0f1979ad1d139cf5fe7f69d.png[/img]

We’ve also added some more outfits for your customization pleasure. Some of them you’ll find at Olivia’s Outfits in town, while others will be received on satisfying certain criteria. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/1fdab2d9127a22560972e869402be704daecd565.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/55bdba9bc12be95436e6048648d2ad049641132c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/2c946f4b5a23acee1f235c10dc2c80751a038630.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/21863a48e8d607457cfd9b008624440d532013e8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/b0a751a656695ce34db48e619b3df12dfcf90e53.png[/img]

To top it off, we’ve added ‘Armor Visuals’ which apply when using Luisa’s base outfit only – This allows players to see the armor they’re equipping, along with providing amazing new looks for pads, leggings, and body armor! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/82d8367dcf57fb568741d3abc6e36197e123f8ae.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/fc57c237078df45064a0600b2ad66d19b0790788.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/fb0b2b2a838565d967f54cbb803e093ccfc28bfa.png[/img]

Finally, 9 new achievements will provide more goals to work towards, offering new challenges for seasoned players looking to test their skills. 

[h3]ITEMISED LIST OF UPDATES, CHANGES & FIXES [/h3]
[b]New: [/b] 
[list]
[*] New Game + is now available! You can play through the game from the start, while keeping your last playthrough's inventory, player stats, and most of the perks that you received from relationship level-ups! In addition, you can choose to either keep your past relationship progress or to reset it.
[*] Extra New Game + content:
[*] 9 new achievements
[*] 4 new attack conduits
[*] Perks, charms, and gear exclusive to NG+
[*] New enemy behaviors (selected enemies now have melee shields, some have more intense attacks or increased ranges, more enemies have magic shields)
[*] 3 new offerings at Olivia’s Outfits (Alpine Athlete - in 3 editions, Catgirl, Superfan)
[*] A Kai outfit you can get by resetting relationships and hanging out with Kai
[*] A new, monstrous outfit as a reward for finishing all Monster Club tasks!
[*] Armor visuals - see what you’re equipping, with amazing new looks for your pads, leggings, and body armor! (This only applies to Luisa’s base outfit)
[/list]

[b]Fixed/Reworked: [/b] [list]
[*] Improved performance on Steam Deck.
[*] Reduced save game file sizes.  
[*] Fixed text overflow in the shop screens in some languages. 
[*] Removed obsolete inputs from settings.  
[*] Fixed a bug where the reward for completing the second relationship level with the dog sometimes didn’t appear. 
[*] Fixed a bug where Luisa’s equipped costume reverted to her default outfit when loading a save game. 
[*] Fixed a bug which led to performance issues when saving the game in quick progression on weaker machines. 
[*] Fixed a bug which sometimes blocked user input for a few seconds after the game started. 
[*] Fixed a bug where using Whirlwind in the Forest Labyrinth could lead to an infinite black screen. 
[/list]

🤫  5143287824

notes.title: Charming RPG Dungeons of Hinterberg ramps up the style in new update
notes.content:
2024 has been a pretty fantastic year so far, with the likes of Black Myth Wukong, the Elden Ring DLC, and Like a Dragon Infinite Wealth just some of the best RPGs we've been blessed with. Among all those, however, my favorite has been a smaller entry - charming indie adventure Dungeons of Hinterberg, which blends Zelda-style dungeon delving with a gorgeous Alpine setting, a helping of political misdemeanors, and a satisfying fantasy twist. Now, a new update makes it even better, and you can snag it cheap in a Steam sale if you've yet to make the trip for yourself.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Our Slay in Style Content Update is here!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers! We hope you’ve been having fun in Hinterberg over the last couple of months - it's been amazing seeing all of you exploring, puzzling and slaying! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/7a8a5f83bb743fc4790f5e787e868e1269e09efe.jpg[/img]

Today, we bring you the first content update – Slay in Style! Taking a stroll through the shopping street, you might notice a new store near the bridge called ‘Olivia’s Outfits’. Here, you’ll be able to purchase a variety of outfits so that you can put your own spin on Luisa. Whether you want to be a member of the Monster Club, embody the Day Tourist style, or fully embrace the Austrian culture in Lederhosen, there is an outfit for you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/9f67ae292cfda86df7aa5185e892972ab9822186.jpg[/img]

You will also have more options in Photo Mode. You will now have multiple filters and overlays to choose from, as well as 10 poses for Luisa to strike! You will be able to view the photos you’ve taken in full screen as well to fully appreciate your artistic efforts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/433703ae574fc53e1c4b97a82b9229e70240668f.png[/img]

There is also now a way to purchase Dungeons of Hinterberg and ensure you’re supporting the Microbird team directly. We’ve bundled together the full game, original soundtrack and digital artbook. Happy slaying/listening/reading! 
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/44817/Dungeons_of_Hinterberg__Supporter_Bundle/

On top of all of this, we have quality of life updates and bug fixes that will make gameplay even smoother. See below for a full breakdown: 
[list]
[*] NEW: Added New playable outfits for Luisa  
[*] NEW: A new Outfit shop in the village 
[*] NEW: Photomode Enhancements - Choose from different filters, poses and borders  
[*] NEW: Added full screen mode when viewing photos in the photo album 
[*] NEW: The stamp book now shows which ‘Commemorative Coins’ you’ve already collected 
[*] NEW: Added "arachnophobia" setting in the settings menu, giving spiders in the game a different look 
[*] FIXED: An issue where the player can walk in the air while holding the battery gem 
[*] FIXED: An issue where Tatzelwurm can be damaged by the ‘Wrecking Ball’ in phase 1, even though it is not knocked down 
[*] FIXED: An issue that causes the PhotoMode camera to clip out of bounds 
[*] FIXED: An issue where Luisa can be slightly displaced when entering Photomode 
[*] FIXED: A bug causing the UI to be hidden when taking a photo at the same time as closing photo mode 
[*] FIXED: A bug in Snowy Summit on the push-block puzzle where the icicle would not collide with the block any more after loading into the level from a save game. (This fix will not restore already broken save games) 
[*] FIXED: Butterfly Barrage target is offset when target locking Wassermann foot in stage 2 of boss fight 
[*] FIXED: Attack Conduits 'Flame Breath', 'Meteor Shower', 'Snowball', and 'Whirlwind' are affected by 'Perfect Dodge' slowdown. 
[*] FIXED: Magic Spells 'Wind Projectile', 'Whirlwind', 'Jelly Block', 'Plasma Ball', 'Light Ray', and 'Hover Board' are affected by 'Perfect Dodge' slowdown 
[*] FIXED: An issue causing speech bubbles to be visible in photomode 
[*] FIXED: An issue where input prompts could remain visible on screen in rare instances 
[*] FIXED: An issue where relationship rewards of People were shown on the map incorrectly 
[*] FIXED: An issue where the exploding fruit in Grove dungeons would not collide with vine fences 
[*] FIXED: An issue where Alex could disappear during the onion festival 
[*] FIXED: A potential soft-lock on the Ice block puzzle in Snowman Summit 
[*] FIXED: Inverted Controller controls during Basilisk boss fight 
[*] FIXED: An issue where a black screen would be visible at startup 
[/list]

🤫  5990804668

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/6f59f3aed7c0df26cf3ebf087a39fa470d07dcdb.jpg[/img]

We hope you have fun exploring the new features – let us know how you get on and share your progress with us on [url=https://twitter.com/MicrobirdGames]X[/url] and in our [url=https://discord.gg/BAgvZGWstD]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Our first patch is here!
notes.content:
We hope you’ve enjoyed your time in Hinterberg so far over the last few weeks! We have loved seeing what you’ve been getting up to over on the [url=https://discord.gg/BAgvZGWstD]Discord[/url] and on [url=https://x.com/MicrobirdGames]X[/url]. We’ve also really appreciated you taking the time to give feedback on how the game is running and any issues you’ve encountered. We’ve been listening and working hard behind the scenes and are now very happy to bring you our first patch with updated and new features! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/98ee752a2161fd33398c180109fc0f7d7623f5dd.jpg[/img]

[b]New:[/b]​​[list][*] ​Enhanced rich presence – Added more detailed information about where in Dungeons of Hinterberg your friends are currently exploring (Steam/Epic specific)
[*] Controller buttons can now be remapped in the settings 
[*] FOV Slider
[*] Added a second auto-save slot which saves every day at noon, when entering a overworld 
[/list]

[b]Fixed/Reworked:[/b]  
[list][*]Reworked Waystones: Upon activating a Waystone, you will now have the option to continue from a Waystone’s position whenever you re-enter the dungeon. 
[*] Reworked framerate cap setting to fix potential screen tearing 
[*] Behavior of inverted controller axis setting during side view and top-down perspectives 
[*] Issue where players could end up in an unresponsive state when dying during specific moments in combat 
[*] Incorrect breakfast comments by Marina if you unlock breakfast reward very late in the game 
[*] Disabled low health vignette during cutscenes 
[*] Added failsafe to prevent entering Overgrown Cave dungeon before access is restored in the story 
[*] An issue that could cause a crash when talking to characters ​with familiarity less than 25 when playing in Simplified Chinese 
[*] Minor localization fixes 
[*] Minor collider and visual bugs 
[*] Rare visual bug for eyeballs in ice cave dungeons when reloading a save game 
[*] ​A possible issue that prevented players from successfully receiving the completion stamp on Snowy Summit 
[*] A bug where some NPC stories were delayed too long by other characters 
[*] If a player misses the Commemorative Coin in the Beginner’s Dungeon, the coin can be purchased in the Souvenir Shop, guaranteeing that the “Collector” achievement is always possible 
[/list]

As always, join us on [url=https://x.com/MicrobirdGames]X[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/BAgvZGWstD]Discord[/url] to talk all things Hinterberg with the devs and fellow adventurers!

🤫  7210273368

notes.title: Action-Adventure RPG Dungeons of Hinterberg Coming Soon

[previewyoutube=DP4nlqQBU7I;full][/previewyoutube]
